name: ui-runtime-click
description: Click Play Mode runtime UI at a screen position. Tries uGUI and UI Toolkit at the same bottom-left-origin coordinates used by ui-control-find. Requires Play Mode and allowStateMutation:true to mutate.

framework.description: Framework scope. all/auto (default) tries uGUI and UI Toolkit at the position; ugui/uitoolkit force one.

targetPath.description: Optional explicit uGUI GameObject path or UI Toolkit VisualElement path.

visualElementRef.description: Optional UI Toolkit visualElementRef from runtime reads/probes.

normalized.description: Normalized bottom-left-origin screen position, where 0,0 is bottom-left and 1,1 is top-right.

sequence.description: uGUI click sequence. pointer sends pointer enter/down/up/click; submit sends EventSystem submit.

dryRun.description: Report resolved targets and intended handlers without firing events.

allowStateMutation.description: Required true for non-dry-run clicks because callbacks may mutate game state.
